_notice: Clinical Drug Interaction Dataset & Risk Rules (PRD F9 & Section 9)

interactions.description: Severe bleeding risk due to synergistic anticoagulant and antiplatelet inhibition.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid concurrent use unless strictly indicated under specialist hematology supervision with frequent INR monitoring.

interactions.description: Increased risk of severe gastrointestinal ulceration and major bleeding.
interactions.recommendation: Use alternative analgesic/anti-inflammatory (e.g. Paracetamol) instead of NSAIDs.

interactions.description: Ibuprofen may attenuate the antiplatelet effect of low-dose aspirin and increase GI side effects.
interactions.recommendation: Take aspirin at least 30 minutes before or 8 hours after ibuprofen.

interactions.description: Ciprofloxacin may alter blood glucose levels when co-administered with antidiabetic agents.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood glucose levels frequently during concurrent therapy.

interactions.description: Amlodipine increases plasma concentration of Simvastatin, raising risk of myopathy/rhabdomyolysis.
interactions.recommendation: Limit Simvastatin dose to maximum 20mg daily when taken with Amlodipine.
